Every finding passes the findings to fixes record checks and the annoyance checks.
Every confirmed entry is exactly one finding, and every taste call also has one palette brief.

required: Use the confirmed ranking; leave out entries the person removed and say so.
Give each finding a located quote, a measurement with its category, frequency, pain, score and who it affects, and the reproduction steps.
Propose findings-to-fixes.reproduce, propose-fix, fix, verify-fix and add-regression-guard, and list them in the finding's work as pending; the verification reruns the same steps and measure.
Record every confirmed entry as a finding; for each one the person marked as taste, also write a palette brief instead of choosing a fix.
Record pain 4 as a design flaw; write low confidence into the finding's note and keep its severity at P3 until more sessions confirm it.
Run the findings to fixes record checks and the annoyance checks on every finding.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.
